newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers head up again, finally drawing buyers.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers head up again, finally drawing buyers.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers rose again on Monday, finally drawing in buyers who were sceptical of price hikes last week, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at $102/$103 fob, a gain of about $1 on Friday's close. The strength came as buyers in the barge market bid $99, but found few sellers.
After a lacklustre week of bunker activity, buyers came out in force. A healthy number of enquiries also gave most suppliers a few pickings.
"There was very much more demand today and most of it in good sized pieces," one dealer said.
Hamburg fuel oil added around $4 a tonne to Friday's closing levels as Rotterdam's strength consolidated. However, bunker enquiries were no higher than normal.
Mediterranean prices were broadly steady, although Spanish prices were $1 a tonne down. Only French markets showed some improvement on last week.
Further east, Egyptian prices were little changed. Supplies were good, including in Alexandria which had been tight.
Fujairah was quiet with many Islamic countries closed for the Eid al-Fitr holiday.
